name: Gehennas's Conjure Flame Orb spawns on him and walks a straight line to the target's cast-time spot
contract: Conjure Flame Orb (2105417) cast but produced nothing: Spell.dbc EFFECT_1 only triggers 2180023 'Cosmetic - Camera Shake Big', a client-only visual with no SUMMON effect, so the orb creature has to be summoned by script on the dummy effect (EFFECT_0). The orb (entry 80644, db.exil.es export) now spawns on Gehennas, not at the target, and walks (MovePoint, not MoveFollow) to the position its target held when the 5000ms cast (SpellCastTimes.dbc index 6) completed, arriving as its measured 11000ms lifetime ends, self-casting the periodic pulse 2105418 the whole way so it burns anything it passes through. This case drives Conjure Flame Orb directly from the boss fixture (bypassing the schedule engine's own target selection, which a focused CoaBossAI.cpp unit/registration check would need to cover separately) and checks: the orb is not already at the target's position right after the cast completes (it has to walk there first), it deals Flame Orb damage once it arrives, and a target that moves away after the cast is not followed.

steps.label: CONTROL: the hero is in Molten Core
CONTROL: boss and hero start 30 yd apart, so the orb has somewhere to walk
Controlled baseline health so damage deltas are unambiguous
Controlled baseline health so damage deltas are unambiguous
Beacon health before the cast (beacon starts co-located with hero, the cast-time target position)
Gehennas casts Conjure Flame Orb at the hero
Let the 5000ms cast complete and the orb spawn
The orb spawned on Gehennas, not at the target: the co-located beacon has taken nothing yet
The hero moves away after the cast; the orb must not follow
Hero health right after moving away
Let the orb finish its walk to the hero's original (beacon's) spot and pulse there
The orb reached the original target spot and burned the beacon standing there
The orb did not follow the hero to the new spot
